ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
An inclined plane body with inclination angle $\alpha$ and mass M is at rest on a horizontal tabletop, and a wooden block of mass m is at rest on the inclined plane body. Which of the following conclusions is correct? (　　)
A. The magnitude of the friction force on the wooden block is $mgcos\alpha$
B. The magnitude of the pressure of the wooden block on the inclined plane body is $mgsin\alpha$
C. The magnitude of the friction force of the tabletop on the inclined plane body is $mgsin\alpha cos\alpha$
D. The magnitude of the supporting force of the tabletop on the inclined plane body is (M＋m)g
